svg.title: Four ways to stamp a picture
svg.desc: A blitter puts a picture on the canvas in one of four ways. The canvas holds a soft band of light, and the picture is a bright diamond in a square box whose corners hold nothing. Copy replaces the canvas with the whole box, so the empty corners cut a dark square into the band. Transparent replaces it only where the picture has something. Brighter keeps the brighter of the two pixels. Add adds them, up to the brightest level, so the diamond is brighter where it crosses the band. A blitter can also mirror the picture or trim it at the canvas's edges.
svg.text: STAMPING A PICTURE ONTO THE CANVAS
